title: Orthography unit (0.2)
description: One JSONL line per teachable script unit (kana, hangul jamo, diacritics, ...). Language-neutral: the engine never interprets `script` or `mnemonic`; it only schedules and renders them.

script.description: Free-form script label for grouping (e.g. hiragana, hangul). Display/grouping only.

reading.description: The canonical reading the learner maps the symbol to (romanization, roman letter name, ...).

name.description: LETTER-UNIT-MODEL-001: the letter's spoken name (бэ, ка, گ). Optional; a letter entity is {form, name, sound}, and where a script has no per-letter name the reading doubles as it.

sound.description: LETTER-UNIT-MODEL-001: the sound this letter maps to, separated from the name. The letter→sound / sound→letter drill dimensions key on this; default derived from `reading` when absent.

confusable_with.description: LETTER-UNIT-MODEL-001 rule 4: single glyphs (typically Latin lookalikes: В→B, Н→H, Р→P, С→C, У→Y) that a learner of THIS script will confuse with this letter. Drives confusable-pair discrimination and the sequencing stagger: confusable letters must never be introduced back-to-back.

mnemonic.description: Optional memory story shown on introduction.
